title: Robust, persistent adaptive immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 in the oropharyngeal lymphoid tissue of children
data_availability_statement: As sequencing data were collected from children, who are considered a vulnerable population, raw CITE-seq data are available upon request to corresponding authors. All other data are provided with the article or upon request from the corresponding authors. Source data for figures will be provided with this article.
